text.en:
and organized into an independent barrio under the name
of Bayong. The batrio of Bayong as herein constituted
shall consist of the area included in the following bounda-
From point 1, which is a Balete tree about 120 meters southwest
of the intersection of the barrio road connecting the sitio, now bar-
rio, of Bayong with the provincial road and a creek without a name
emptying into the Abaca creek, as shown in the sketch map of the
proposed barrio of Bayong and its mother barrio Lungsudaan, Sier-
ra-Bullones, Bohol Province, prepared and submitted February 10,
1947 by the district engineer of Bohol, in a straight line due N.
32°E. to point 2, which is a Gakit tree on the south bank of the
Abaca creek; thence southeastward meandering and following the
course of this creek to point 3, which is a Pili tree located somewhere
east of the east bank of the most south-easterly portion of this creek;
thence S. 36°W. in a straight line to point 4, which is a Tawoto tree;
thence N. 61°W. on Canlomain hill in a straight line to point 5,
which is a Tugas tree; thence N. 15°E. in a straight line to the point
of beginning.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of April, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
cf the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
